name: Joshua
source:
This is your normal now: Leaving the house means wrestling paranoia, silencing empathy, cutting off old friends.

You don’t get it? Of course not. Everything dead must go. So cut it.

[From [url=https://lawrest.itch.io/joshua]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
现在这是你的常态：离开家意味着与偏执狂作斗争，压制同理心，切断老朋友的联系。

你不明白吗？当然不是。一切死去的东西都必须消失。所以剪掉吧。

[来自[url=https://lawrest.itch.io/joshua]Itch.io[/url]]
